page.notes: Show-through from the facing page and the scan's left edge hide the first letters of many lines; these are marked [?] where I could not confirm them. Doubtful readings: "Trebeliano" (only "ano" is clear), the figure after §. in the line beginning "o.t.25.l.3." (read as 9), "Patenum" (line 13 of the column), "Doctriva" (printed form, possibly a misprint for Doctrina), and "Medici" (the word before ", 15."). The line "l." under the Curæ entry is a fragment of the reference "t.25.l.1." hidden by show-through. The Roman numeral 14 in "Militia" line may be partly obscured. Printing errors are left as printed.
